about.heroSubtitle: China's benchmark enterprise for building-materials display props — the first service provider focused on stone, tile, and wood-flooring display R&D, production, and sales.
about.storyP1: TSIANFAN (Xiamen) Industry & Trade Co., Ltd. is located in Xiamen, the earliest special economic zone developed in China. Founded in 2008, it is the benchmark enterprise of China's building-materials display props and the first service provider focusing on stone, tile, wood-flooring display design, R&D, production, and sales.
about.storyP2: 80% of the company's products are sold to well-known brand companies in Europe and the United States. Our business covers the US, UK, Canada, France, Italy, Germany, and other developed countries. We have won the support and trust of many partners including TCE, NEOLITH, COLOR QUARTZ, CAESARSTONE, CERALSIO, VICOSTONE, VIATERA, COSMOS, SOCI and 100+ well-known brands.
about.storyP3: We have complete iron, wood production and manufacturing equipment, large-scale automation professional equipment, and a supporting powder coating line. From pre-structural design, process development, and mold production to shipment and after-sales service, we provide professional one-stop solutions.
